evals.name: Report weak and missing sections of a locked intent without changing it
evals.prompt: Use the intent-bundle skill to check the intent 'label-reprint'. In this environment the intents root is intents-root/ (not ~/Documents/intents) and repoDir is intents-root/repo. GitHub and git are unavailable, so don't pull. Write the check, one line per required section plus one line about the lock, to check-report.md.
evals.allowed_tools: Read Write Edit Glob Grep Skill
expectations: Proposed outcome is rated weak because it has no testable success criterion.
Out of scope is rated missing.
The report says the intent is locked.

evals.name: Report a complete, unlocked intent as complete
evals.prompt: Use the intent-bundle skill to check intent 8. In this environment the intents root is intents-root/ (not ~/Documents/intents) and repoDir is intents-root/repo. GitHub and git are unavailable, so don't pull. Write the check, one line per required section plus one line about the lock, to check-report.md.
evals.allowed_tools: Read Write Edit Glob Grep Skill
expectations: Every required section is rated good enough.
The report says the intent isn't locked.
